title: FastAPI Basics 🚀
ques: Initialize a **FastAPI** app and create an async route `/items/{item_id}` that returns the item ID.
explanation: FastAPI uses modern Python type hints. Here, `item_id` is automatically validated as an integer.

title: Query Parameters 🔍
ques: Define a function that accepts an optional query parameter `q` (string).
explanation: Function parameters that are not part of the path parameters are interpreted as **query parameters**.

title: Automatic Documentation 📑
ques: Where can you access the automatic **interactive API documentation** generated by FastAPI?
explanation: FastAPI automatically generates documentation based on the OpenAPI standard using your function definitions and type hints.
